name: Activity Inbox
description: An inbox of activity grouped by day, filtered by tabs, with unread marks and inline actions.

props.name: items
props.description: The notifications, newest first: { id, kind, group, actor, message, time, avatar?, icon?, tone?, quote?, unread?, actions? }. kind is "mention", "system" or "activity" and decides the tab; group is the heading it sits under, such as "Today".

props.name: defaultTab
props.description: The tab shown first. Activity items appear only under All.

props.name: onMarkAllRead
props.description: Called by the "Mark all read" button. The unread marks clear in place, top to bottom.

props.name: onMarkRead
props.description: Called when one item is marked read, from its hover control or by using one of its actions.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Called with the item id and the action id when an action button such as Reply is pressed.

props.name: listHeight
props.description: Height of the scrolling list in pixels, kept the same on every tab.

props.name: emptyStates
props.description: Replaces the text shown when a tab has nothing in it.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the panel. Also accepts every other section attribute.
